method: Separate post-draft read of the complete saved report, checked against the frozen archive and named retained receipts; style judgment is editorial, not authorship detection.
genre: Short technical release-review report and vote.
coverage: Entire panel/rose/README.md, all 13 lines; checked claims against the actual archive and the evidence records listed in verdict.json.
score_reason: The report is specific and proportionate to an audit, with little stock framing. Its compact evidence language and repeated status qualifications are somewhat formal, but help preserve release boundaries.
confidence_reason: The report is short and the style cues are clear, while perceived-style scoring remains subjective and has no validated calibration.
